status: Restricted analytic stability test; no successful complete interaction
general_result: For timelike X>0, negative scalar enthalpy requires P_X<0. If K=P_X+2XP_XX>0, c_s^2<0. K<0 is a ghost. K=0 is degenerate and requires a different analysis.
atomic_trial: epsilon=1, mu=n^2, fixed masses/charge: leading optical frequency fixed, hyperfine proportional to n^2. Multiplying the nuclear magnetic moment by n^-2 cancels only the leading hyperfine term.
scope: Applies to minimally coupled P(phi,X) with a healthy short-wavelength EFT regime and ordinary other matter. Derivative gravity and full matter couplings can change the quadratic coefficients.
